title: Fatal shots justified: SIU: [Ontario Edition]
article: Two Toronto police officers were legally justified in fatally shooting 29-year-old John Menga as he tried to escape in a stolen vehicle, the Special Investigations Unit has concluded.

"Menga was clearly operating the Jeep in a threatening fashion and with total disregard for ... safety," SIU director Peter Tinsley said in a statement released yesterday. The provincial unit probes all serious injuries or death involving police in Ontario.

The SIU investigation showed that constables Paul Lentsch and Bobby Grewal spotted Menga Feb. 1. in the stolen Jeep Grand Cherokee parked on Bloor St., west of Havelock St. They ordered Menga and his passenger out, but Menga sped off and lost control of the car. After regaining control, he drove at the officers, who were out of their cruiser, according to the SIU. Both officers fired at Menga, striking him several times. His passenger was unhurt.
